# Khair Aljaar Foods (خير الجوار للأغذية)

> Jeddah food house for wholesale and export. Fresh and frozen produce — citrus, dates, fruits, vegetables, grocery, poultry, and IQF lines — coordinated from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. An Egypt branch is listed for local contact. Site languages: English and Arabic. Prices and availability are confirmed on an official quotation.

Also known as: Khair Aljaar, Khair Aljewar, Khair Aljaar Group, خير الجوار. Group companies named on the site: Tasami Al-Wataniya, Al Rehan Al Masi Poultry (الريحان الماسي), Thimar Ardina.

## Facts you can rely on
- Hub: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Address on the site: Abu Ma'ali Al-Hadari, Al-Safa, Jeddah 23454.
- Saudi phone and email are published on the contact page. Egypt branch phone: +20 112 204 9900.
- Business model: wholesale and export. Minimum order is shown per product and confirmed on quote.
- Listed prices are indicative. Final offers follow grade, volume, and Incoterm.
- Contact: https://khairaljewargroup.com/en/contact
